title: r-releaser manifest
description: Metadata sidecar produced by build-src/build-bin/build-docs, merged by merge-manifests, attached to the GitHub Release as manifest.json, and consumed by deploy-prism. Keys are release asset filenames; values describe the artifact. Runtime validation is implemented dependency-free in shared/manifest-schema.js and must be kept in sync with this file.

sourceEntry.description: Written by build-src for the source tarball. Carries caller metadata (arbitrary scalar fields, e.g. PrismRemoteRef, GitOrigin, GitSHA) used by deploy workflows to resolve provenance.

binaryEntry.description: Written by build-bin per built binary. os_codename embeds the /etc/os-release ID plus major version (e.g. almalinux8) and must map through shared/platforms.json at deploy time.

docsEntry.description: Written by build-docs for the pkgdown site tarball. deploy-prism posts these assets to {prism_api_url}/documents/{package}/versions/{version} instead of /packages.
